description: This PHP source file defines the TranslationsCommand class, which manages translation texts and YAML export/import for the Goteo project. It includes command configuration, execution logic for listing, dumping, and deleting translation data, and interacts with application components like Lang, Text, and YAML.

classes.name: TranslationsCommand
classes.description: A console command class for managing translations, including listing, dumping, and deleting translation data in YAML format.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, options, and help text for the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command logic based on input options, including listing languages, dumping YAML files, and deleting SQL translation entries.
